description.value: Osaka Sushi & Oshi is a fast-food Japanese counter located in the food court (concourse level, unit FC-18) of Harbour Centre in downtown Vancouver. The OSM record links it to the Hiro Japan Sushi Xpress brand, which has operated quick-serve sushi counters in BC food courts since 2003, though the Harbour Centre location no longer appears on that brand's website. The differing name and absent listing suggest the unit may have changed operators or closed.
